description: This PHP script retrieves and outputs configuration templates for issue tracker types in the TestLink project. It initializes the page, determines the issue tracker type from request parameters, and attempts to load and display its configuration template or an error message if unavailable.

classes.name: tlIssueTracker
classes.description: A class managing issue tracker types and their configurations.

methods.name: getImplementationForType
methods.description: Returns the class name implementing a specific issue tracker type.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Returns configuration template for the issue tracker.
